summary: Editable Hybrid LibreOffice readback is a separate same-RC capability and never falls back into the public Fidelity flow.
invariants: Require one fresh seal binding source, profile, policy, worker, provider, font, and exporter digests.
Require known-good control then exact RC PPTX readback with an invocation-owned LibreOffice profile.
Classify environment_unavailable, invocation_failed, and document_invalid separately.
forbidden: Do not treat Fidelity evidence or a PowerPoint save-copy as Editable Hybrid LibreOffice evidence.
Do not enable public flow from this capability before its gates pass.
